rationale: Price has just expanded nearly $2.00 in three minutes—more than 3.5 times the 5-minute ATR ($0.54)—and is now extended above both VWAP ($43.91) and the 9-EMA ($43.47) right into yesterday's low ($45.34) as potential overhead resistance.
